prompt:
A pristine, high-fidelity software interface screenshot of a morning briefing, an automated daily summary built by a marketing director in AI & Agents Professional, shown perfectly front-on and centered on a deep electric cobalt (#2D4BFF) field with generous even margins on all sides.
Interface: white panels, near-black (#111114) text in a clean neo-grotesque typeface, cool grey 1px hairlines, small uppercase monospace labels, one cobalt highlight on the number 2. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Morning briefing · Tue"; "3 meetings need prep"; "2 decisions waiting on you". Add realistic secondary details in small grey text so it reads as a real working tool.
Around the panel, on the cobalt field: fine thin white technical drawing marks like a designer's annotated blueprint (construction lines, dimension arrows, small registration circles and crosshairs, no words), plus three or four small white four-point sparkle glints. Very soft shadow under the panel. No device frame, no browser chrome, no people, no hands, no perspective tilt, no gradients, no logos.
